description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ZT Systems is hiring a Software Developer to develop and implement software solutions for its manufacturing processes. The role involves building and maintaining manufacturing software, integrating third-party systems, collaborating across teams, and improving software quality and development processes.
Test Software Developer building and maintaining manufacturing software, integrating third-party systems to automate processes and ensure reliability

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain software solutions for our manufacturing software, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define software requirements, design, and implement solutions
• Build software that integrates with third-party services and systems to automate manufacturing processes
• Ensure code quality, performance, and maintainability of software
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve the software and the development process
• Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing technologies and trends

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field or an advanced degree with equivalent work experience
• 0 - 3 years of experience in software development
• Experience with containerization technologies such as Linux, Windows , System board interfaces (i.e. I2C, PCIE, IPMI, and Redfish hardware interfaces), and networked communication protocols (i.e. TCP/IP, UDP)
• Proficient in programming languages such as Python, C/C++/C#, Java, JavaScript, Shell / Bash script
• Strong understanding of software design principles, patterns, and best practices
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in a team environment

Preferred:
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes and technologies is a plus
